commands.command:
"<USER>\\.cache\\codex-runtimes\\codex-primary-runtime\\dependencies\\native\\powershell\\pwsh.exe" -Command 'New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path skills -Force | Out-Null
Copy-Item -LiteralPath mirror/current-export -Destination skills/current-export -Recurse
$sourcePath = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath input.json).Path
$sourceBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($sourcePath)
$inputData = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($sourceBytes) | ConvertFrom-Json
$total = 0
foreach ($value in $inputData.values) { $total += $value }
$inputHash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath input.json -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
$result = [ordered]@{ generation = $inputData.generation; total = $total; input_sha256 = $inputHash }
$json = $result | ConvertTo-Json
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path (Get-Location) '"'output.json'), "'$json + [Environment]::NewLine, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
python -c "import json, hashlib, pathlib; raw = pathlib.Path('"'input.json').read_bytes(); src = json.loads(raw); out = json.loads(pathlib.Path('output.json').read_bytes()); expected = dict(generation=src['generation'], total=sum(src['values']), input_sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()); assert out == expected, (out, expected); print('Independent validation passed'); print(json.dumps(out))\""
